_comment: ppr_ceiling: the most one combined case may total when the head's Director (Admin) power is 'PPR full' (null = no cap). vat_method: 'inclusive' (VAT = total×15/115, base = total − VAT, tax = 2% of base; the user's utils/vat-tax-calc.ods and the sample-1 pass letter) or 'gross' (15% and 2% of the total, sample-4 audit note). attestation: the hand-written certificate on every voucher, the same for every case (no wings or parts); {work} is the head's 'attestation_work' in heads.json.
attestation: প্রত্যয়ন করা যাইতেছে যে, {work} মেরামত কাজে উল্লেখিত অর্থ যথাযথভাবে ব্যয়িত হয়েছে।
